per_game.drive: Fresh launch, complete a race, retry, audio and selection performance acceptable
per_game.freeplay: Start and restart without inserting a coin; survives exit and relaunch
per_game.manual-hpattern: Select MANUAL; engage and hold gears 1-4, neutral and downshift correctly
per_game.manual-sequential: Select MANUAL; each paddle press changes one gear, hold does not run through gears
per_game.rebind: Bind, rebind, relaunch: new control works, old control stops; other bindings remain
per_game.ffb: Correct restoring direction, comparable default weight, distinct car/wall impacts, no oscillation or stuck force
per_game.graphics: Default full widescreen + CRT; inspect selection and complete gameplay including margins, sky, shadows and collisions
per_game.exit: Esc menu opens/resumes; exit returns to launcher; F12 fallback and immediate relaunch work

shared.renderer-startup: Resolve or explain the observed pre-race GL consumer timeout; retain failed evidence and pass a documented repeated cold-start stress test before release
shared.fresh-package: Extract exact candidate ZIP on a clean Windows profile without Python or development paths; import user ROMs, launch all four games
shared.upgrade: Upgrade/import preserves wheel bindings, scores, calibration and chosen display/force settings; rollback verified
shared.wheel-matrix: Record wheel/base firmware and driver settings; validate local wheel plus a second vendor (Fanatec oscillation report), disconnect/reconnect and no-wheel startup
shared.soak: At least 30 minutes mixed gameplay with repeated game switching; no accumulating slowdown, crash, stuck input/force or capture-related periodic stutter
shared.package-review: Exact ZIP/hash reviewed: no ROMs or personal rig data, runtime DLLs and source/licences present, installer/updater/support bundle work, release notes list remaining limitations
shared.ci: All required CI jobs pass on the candidate source revision; attach the run URL or exported report
